@graph.name: How to Start an EarlyJobs Recruitment Franchise
@graph.description: The application and onboarding process for prospective EarlyJobs franchise partners.

step.name: Submit Your Interest
step.text: Complete the franchise application form to express interest in the opportunity.

step.name: Application Review and Discussion
step.text: EarlyJobs reviews the application and discusses the opportunity and prospective partner's requirements.

step.name: Agreement and Documentation
step.text: Review and complete the applicable franchise documentation and agreement.

step.name: Onboarding and Training
step.text: Complete the onboarding and recruitment training included in the franchise programme.

step.name: Franchise Launch
step.text: Prepare to launch local recruitment operations in accordance with the agreed plan.

step.name: Ongoing Support and Growth
step.text: Use the applicable operational guidance and support to develop the local recruitment business.

mainEntity.name: Do I need HR experience to start an EarlyJobs franchise?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prior HR experience is not required according to the EarlyJobs franchise page. The programme provides training covering recruitment, operations and sales processes.

mainEntity.name: What is the investment required to start an EarlyJobs franchise?

acceptedAnswer.text: The investment depends on the applicable franchise fee, office or home-office setup, equipment and working capital. Prospective partners should confirm the current fee and total investment directly with EarlyJobs before making a decision.

mainEntity.name: How do I apply for an EarlyJobs recruitment franchise?

acceptedAnswer.text: Submit the franchise interest form on the EarlyJobs website. The application is reviewed, followed by a discussion, documentation, onboarding and training for approved partners.

mainEntity.name: What support does EarlyJobs provide to franchise partners?

acceptedAnswer.text: The franchise programme describes support for recruitment training, operations, launch and business development. The specific scope of support is subject to the applicable franchise agreement.
